name: Dream Club Gogo.
source: Dream C Club gives the interaction and playability lacking in the big majority of galge. It also embraces being a charage more than most PC-based eroge, getting rid of any central plot to focus only on the heroines and their short stories for character development.
translation: 《Dream C Club》透過互動和可玩性，彌補了絕大多數美少女遊戲的不足。相比大多數PC平台成人遊戲，它更徹底地擁抱角色遊戲屬性，拋開核心劇情，只專注於女主角及其用於塑造角色的短篇故事。
